subject: Maths
title: Year 7 Maths: Half-term 5 (Geometry: angles, polygons, area and perimeter)

questions.question: Angles around a point are 95°, 120° and $x$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: Angles around a point add to 360°: $360 - 95 - 120 = 145$°.

questions.question: An isosceles triangle has one angle of 40° between its two equal sides. What is each of the other two angles?
Two straight lines cross. One of the angles is 58°. What is the angle vertically opposite it?
Which of these is a reflex angle?
What is the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon?
How many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have?
questions.explanation: A regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as it has sides: 6.

questions.question: A rectangle has perimeter 30 cm and length 9 cm. What is its width?
questions.explanation: $2 \times 9 = 18$; $30 - 18 = 12$ for both widths, so each width is 6 cm.

questions.question: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 12 cm and perpendicular height 5 cm.
A trapezium has parallel sides 6 cm and 10 cm, and height 4 cm. What is its area?
A square has an area of 49 cm². What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Each side is 7 cm (because 7 × 7 = 49), so the perimeter is 4 × 7 = 28 cm.

questions.question: An L-shape is made from a 10 cm × 6 cm rectangle with a 4 cm × 3 cm rectangle cut from one corner. What is its area?
How many cm² are in 1 m²?
